pilotMetrics.title: Pilot measurement
pilotMetrics.lead: Counts aggregated by day and by country, recomputed by a nightly run, to follow the pilot’s usefulness without observing anyone.
pilotMetrics.privacyBadge: Pilot measurements, with no private content
pilotMetrics.unavailableBody: This data provider does not serve the pilot measurement. No figure is shown in its place.
pilotMetrics.restrictedBody: This dashboard is open to DIASPORALE administrators and moderators. It only contains aggregated counts.
pilotMetrics.errorTitle: The measurement could not be loaded
pilotMetrics.notMeasuredBody: Counts are recomputed every night. They will appear here after the first run.
pilotMetrics.fictionalBody: These counts are invented to explore the screen. They describe no real activity.

notes.title: What this measurement does not do
notes.noContent: No request, search, message or review text enters these counts.
notes.noPeople: No person identifier is kept in the aggregates and no individual journey is tracked.
notes.threshold: A count below {{threshold}} is shown as “fewer than {{threshold}}”. A rate is only published when its part and its gap with the base reach that threshold.
notes.cohorts: A request, membership or review counts on the day it was created, with its state at the last run. A place counts on the day of its event.
notes.notMeasured: Searches without results and drop-offs are not measured.

errors.pilot_metrics_window_invalid: This period is not offered. Choose 7, 30 or 90 days.
